about: Cuphead-side systems of the ROUNDS blob. Each row is one method in the Cuphead plugin (symbol) that turns Build stats into gameplay. tuning lists the conversion constants it uses.

columns.symbol: Class.Method in src/CupheadMod that implements it (preflight checks it exists)
columns.tuning: tuning ids used, comma separated, or none

rows.does: Each bullet hits Cuphead enemies for ROUNDS damage x damageScale (times bullet damage multiplier, plus percentage damage as a flat bonus on bosses)
Time between shots is ROUNDS attackSpeed (or the locked attack speed); semi-auto cards need a fresh press
Several projectiles per shot with ROUNDS spread and even spread, bursts with time between bullets
Ammo pips under the blob; reloads automatically when empty or after a pause, ammo regeneration refills over time
Charge cards: holding shoot charges, release fires with charge damage multiplier
Bullets fly at ROUNDS speed with ROUNDS gravity and drag; optional lifetime
Bounces off floors, walls and the screen edge (reflects), smart bounce turns toward the nearest enemy, speed and damage change per bounce
Bigger bullets and bigger hitboxes
Damage grows or shrinks with distance travelled
Ghost bullets pass through ground and walls
Bullet tint from card colours; poison/slow and knockback cards tint and scale the impact effect
Shooting nudges the blob backwards a little, more with recoil cards
ROUNDS max health becomes Cuphead hearts (34 health per heart, up to 9); regeneration and life steal refill hearts; decay cards add a short invulnerability after a hit
Respawn cards bring the blob back with full hearts instead of dying, once per card per level
ROUNDS's own run physics (push, drag, air control from the ROUNDS player prefab), scaled to Cuphead's screen; speed cards scale the push
ROUNDS's jump (impulse plus hold lift), ROUNDS's growing gravity, extra air jumps from cards, ROUNDS wall jump and slide, gravity and jump cards
the real ROUNDS character, animated by ROUNDS (puppet frames), drawn over the hidden Cuphead sprite; a drawn blob only while those frames are not arriving; size cards scale it
ROUNDS block: brief invulnerability and parry, 4 s cooldown changed by cards, extra blocks chain
Healing on block
Block force cards push the blob in the direction held
Auto-block cards block a hit automatically when the block is ready
